other_conditions: Worker must be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Worker must have at least one year of regular membership and an active membership
Worker must add a work experience of at least 90 days in the preceding year to avail the benefit
Worker must pay the registration fee before accessing benefits
Benefits are available for up to three children per worker
Children must be pursuing regular technical/professional courses
benefits_summary: Full reimbursement of educational expenses for children of registered construction workers pursuing professional/technical courses, up to three children per worker.
